standard: MIPI Alliance Specification for System Power Management Interface (SPMI) v2.0
arbitration_sequence: Priority-driven bus arbitration. Masters and slaves arbitrate with 1..3 cycle request sequences.

0x00.name: REG_0_WR
0x00.description: Quick zero-write for low-overhead status clears

0x30.name: EXT_REG_WR
0x30.description: Extended 16-bit register write up to 16 bytes burst

0x38.name: EXT_REG_RD
0x38.description: Extended 16-bit register read up to 16 bytes burst

0x3A.name: EXT_REG_WRL
0x3A.description: Extended long register write up to 32 bytes

0x3E.name: EXT_REG_RDL
0x3E.description: Extended long register read up to 32 bytes

frame_structure.ssc: Sequence Start Condition: High-to-Low transition on SDATA while SCLK is High
frame_structure.command_byte: 8-bit command payload containing opcode and byte count (BC)
frame_structure.data_bytes: N bytes payload with odd parity per byte
frame_structure.bus_park: 1-cycle bus parking condition at end of frame
